In Guangxu 26 the Boxer uprising erupted, the allied armies of the foreign powers took the capital, and Emperor Guangxu led Empress Dowager Cixi west in flight. Yigong, who had long enjoyed the dynasty's favor, was unable to join the imperial flight and burned himself to death.

In Guangxu 26 the Boxer uprising erupted, the allied armies of the foreign powers took the capital, and Emperor Guangxu escorted Empress Dowager Cixi west in flight. Yigong, who had long enjoyed the dynasty's favor, was unable to join the imperial flight and burned himself to death.
德宗奉孝欽顯皇后西狩 has the emperor escorting the empress dowager; led reverses the deference of 奉.

In the twenty-sixth year of Guangxu the Boxers began the calamity; the allied armies of the powers broke the capital; Emperor Dezong escorted Empress Dowager Xiaojin the Manifest west on tour; Yigong, having received the state's grace through generations, could not follow the imperial retinue, and set himself afire.

In the twenty-sixth year of Guangxu the Boxers began the calamity; the allied armies of the powers broke the capital; Emperor Dezong escorted Empress Dowager Xiaoqinxian west on tour; Yigong, having received the state's grace through generations, could not follow the imperial retinue, and set himself afire.
孝欽顯皇后 is the unitary posthumous title Xiaoqinxian. The proposal correctly removes the awkward translated epithet but misspells 欽 (qin) as jin.
He was selected within the capital to be metropolitan prefect of Shuntian, resigned on illness, and was recalled as a Hanlin reader in the Grand Secretariat.

內閣侍讀學士 is a Grand Secretariat reader-attendant academician post, not a Hanlin appointment.
